## Problem and affected revision

Describe the concrete behavior and component. For security-sensitive evidence, follow SECURITY.md instead of posting it here.

## Reproduction

Use synthetic input. Include expected and observed results, environment, and commands where relevant.

## Evidence and impact

Attach minimized output without credentials, personal data, production captures, or private paths. Distinguish confirmed facts from hypotheses.
